rtl/spi_master.sv is an 8-bit SPI master: all four CPOL/CPHA modes,
MSB- or LSB-first (lsb_first), SCLK half-period of `div` clock cycles
(div 1..255). SCLK idles at CPOL. cs_n goes low one half-period before
the first SCLK edge and returns high one half-period after the last edge,
at which point busy drops, done pulses for one cycle and rx holds the
received byte. tb/tb_spi_smoke.sv is the block's smoke test. Make it
signoff-ready at 4 ns. Keep the port list.

b1_cpha1_sample_edge:
if (!pha) begin sh_rx[pos(lsb, bit_rx)] <= miso; bit_rx <= bit_rx + 4'd1; end
              else      begin mosi <= sh_tx[pos(lsb, bit_tx)]; bit_tx <= bit_tx + 4'd1; end

sh_rx[pos(lsb, bit_rx)] <= miso; bit_rx <= bit_rx + 4'd1;
              if (pha) begin mosi <= sh_tx[pos(lsb, bit_tx)]; bit_tx <= bit_tx + 4'd1; end
b3_div_4bit:
logic [3:0] cnt, d;
  logic [7:0] sh_tx, sh_rx;
b5_no_cs_hold: if (edges == 5'd15) begin cs_n <= 1'b1; busy <= 1'b0; done <= 1'b1; rx <= sh_rx; st <= IDLE; end
